mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, it is 43 degrees with clear skies at City Hall, under the light of the Third Quarter moon.

October is officially Community Planning Month, celebrating the Planning and Development Department for their dedication to our city's future, plus there is a new update regarding road construction on Highway M near the future Aldi site, which will be closed from October 6 through October 9 for final paving work.
There is a busy week ahead, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by trivia nights tomorrow at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.
On September 21, a retailer in the 400 block of East Verona Avenue reported a theft of Swedish Fish, leading to a citation for the individual identified on surveillance video.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist, and you can stop by when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
